mekayis.metin: (حَنَوَ) الْحَاءُ وَالنُّونُ وَالْحَرْفُ الْمُعْتَلُّ أَصْلٌ وَاحِدٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى تَعَطُّفٍ وَتَعَوُّجٍ. يُقَالُ حَنَوْتُ الشَّيْءَ حَنْوًا وَحَنَيْتُهُ، إِذَا عَطَفْتَهُ حَنْيًا. وَحِنْوُ السَّرْجِ سُمِّي بِذَلِكَ أَيْضًا، وَجَمْعُهُ أَحْنَاءُ. وَمِنْهُ حَنَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ عَلَى وَلَدِهَا تَحْنُو، وَذَلِكَ إِذَا لَمْ تَتَزَوَّجْ مِنْ بَعْدِ أَبِيهِمْ، وَهُوَ مِنْ تَعَطُّفِهَا عَلَيْهِمْ. وَنَاقَةٌ حَنْوَاءُ: فِي ظَهْرِهَا احْدِيدَابٌ. وَانْحَنَى الشَّيْءُ يَنْحَنِي انْحِنَاءً. وَالْمَحْنِيَّةُ: مُنْعَرَجُ الْوَادِي. وَأَمَّا الْحَنْوَةُ وَالْحِنَّاءُ فَنَبْتَانِ مَعْرُوفَانِ، وَيَجُوزُ أَنْ يَكُونَ ذَلِكَ شَاذًّا عَنِ الْأَصْلِ.

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: حَنَا • (ḥanā) I (non-past يَحْنُو (yaḥnū), verbal noun حَنْو (ḥanw))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Compare ح ن ي (ḥ n y) and حَنَى (ḥanā, “to bend”). Cognate to Hebrew חָנָה (“to decline, bend down”).
g: to peel, to debark (a branch, etc.)

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: حَنَا • (ḥanā) I (non-past يَحْنُو (yaḥnū), verbal noun حُنُوّ (ḥunuww))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Compare ح ن ي (ḥ n y) and حَنَى (ḥanā, “to bend”). Cognate to Hebrew חָנָה (“to decline, bend down”).
g: to be attached to, to be affectionate towards
to care for one's children and not remarry (of a widow)
to submit to a male animal (of a ewe or cow)

kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Shortened form of Arabic يُوحَنَّا (yūḥannā), ultimately from Hebrew יוֹחָנָן (yokhanán, “God is gracious”).
g: a male given name, Hanna, of Christian usage, equivalent to English John

kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
حنا (form I)
# حَنَّا (ḥannā) /ħan.naː/: third-person masculine dual past active of حَنَّ (ḥanna)
# حُنَّا (ḥunnā) /ħun.naː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of حَنَّ (ḥanna)
# حِنَّا (ḥinnā) /ħin.naː/: second-person dual imperative of حَنَّ (ḥanna)

تحني (form I)
# تَحِنِّي (taḥinnī) /ta.ħin.niː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of حَنَّ (ḥanna)
# تُحَنِّي (tuḥannī) /tu.ħan.niː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of حَنَّ (ḥanna)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: اِنْحَنَى • (inḥanā) VII (non-past يَنْحَنِي (yanḥanī), verbal noun اِنْحِنَاء (inḥināʔ))
g: to bend, to curve, to twist, to turn
to lean, to incline [with على; or with فوق ‘over s.th’],
to turn, to deviate, to digress
to bow, to get bent, to bend
arc, camber, low-slung recess, a curved or bowed structure or building

kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.

kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Derived from the active participle of اِنْحَنَى (inḥanā, “to bend, curve”)
